Probiotic drinks and supplements marketed for hangovers (such as  [Highlight start] [ZBiotics Pre-Alcohol](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYQHEIkXXcdWd8uMx0HFNjQWflbrOg7C-ePWk06hEJgNWAKqgUtMspw-2nc7iWdq6v3ZAO2x-JguPyzJVufv3ROLMuFRwF1lxvqCRZGAkNdOgTDKg1FM1kn82WdZXGb1yRPg) [Highlight end] ) contain live or genetically engineered bacteria—like *Bacillus subtilis* or strains like *Leuconostoc mesenteroides* —designed to break down **acetaldehyde** , a toxic alcohol byproduct that builds up in the gut and liver.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYQHEIkXXcdWd8uMx0HFNjQWflbrOg7C-ePWk06hEJgNWAKqgUtMspw-2nc7iWdq6v3ZAO2x-JguPyzJVufv3ROLMuFRwF1lxvqCRZGAkNdOgTDKg1FM1kn82WdZXGb1yRPg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXU2VMJICLlLK5fdEtOWy18rjsigi0Bxa_8_wozd0MUsdu2Thgg1OpDqiVqJyeRc0kHskKD8Rbkla7-1CdskfG8N2vF3t27jVzencoSkM73efZXgxUuiIGsYh_VVnlC-ge0ofJcnKhOGs)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1_O_07k5Qwr0CYRm76vTJacB5Tf6uEnFHEzDXUUcP0JZymBdxYeQJpZtjd7yVl6KfwNOtuIo_WCBMJKJ1VqW7Ue6_MhmWFjFcF9EqfKmIifNXg-3NiVc-25vJovzig9yfzi7R8ZuDoajer3cHPmG0gd6UAbSJo6iQVg5_ka9JSiKKXN7t9fD6jtDJE86hzvdWtoY)

### How They Claim to Work

- **Targeting Acetaldehyde:** Probiotic strains are engineered or selected to mimic liver enzymes (like aldehyde dehydrogenase) to break down acetaldehyde before or as alcohol is processed.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF1-9POGfOq5yIal-Ru0KOsNqQ64JHaQqZz_0KEpQ9Bx0RlWvRZ6FRYl833aS9YLx8v1vD_m9ZHOYds3pzlnAEBpk9RzpLoPiIaPAnhXjMZv_09F8WS9R_bVKBeJiM49RLTRR8dUVpfCWM0XaQuYUV9LNBA9gJtjv7UlPf5ZEaRpKsOvcpAik5vFJf)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYQHEIkXXcdWd8uMx0HFNjQWflbrOg7C-ePWk06hEJgNWAKqgUtMspw-2nc7iWdq6v3ZAO2x-JguPyzJVufv3ROLMuFRwF1lxvqCRZGAkNdOgTDKg1FM1kn82WdZXGb1yRPg)
- **Gut-Liver Axis:** Some studies in animal models and small trials suggest specific strains can help reduce blood ethanol clearance times or lower oxidative stress.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX9BTkohxDxUJ5FXUBKqqKa6K10xkcLYZxgWMw7iSWIHTUB_09-LHD8DXKTj3EX_qNok8hZo2udIAZRqLSHKiLvaoRsvlF1R-I-TsNIyVC_5X2p3rYOoFsxYwlTatiWOtnAHyTdAkEUsU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXU2VMJICLlLK5fdEtOWy18rjsigi0Bxa_8_wozd0MUsdu2Thgg1OpDqiVqJyeRc0kHskKD8Rbkla7-1CdskfG8N2vF3t27jVzencoSkM73efZXgxUuiIGsYh_VVnlC-ge0ofJcnKhOGs)

### What the Science and Experts Say

- **Not a Cure:** Scientists and medical experts note that most alcohol is metabolized in the liver, not the intestines, and a probiotic cannot prevent all hangover effects like dehydration, sleep disruption, or systemic inflammation.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1_O_07k5Qwr0CYRm76vTJacB5Tf6uEnFHEzDXUUcP0JZymBdxYeQJpZtjd7yVl6KfwNOtuIo_WCBMJKJ1VqW7Ue6_MhmWFjFcF9EqfKmIifNXg-3NiVc-25vJovzig9yfzi7R8ZuDoajer3cHPmG0gd6UAbSJo6iQVg5_ka9JSiKKXN7t9fD6jtDJE86hzvdWtoY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXX-Gw_T4fqnJ0VM3GQW_UK7s5dNz6e9_v3EFHth5mOXg4BvSBxQ5kShS5ovgSQfb54CHc-pG6CaeTAjPxPn5xuYZdcVJnnToH5XBtHiMf94Ra2oQmXormPK8-DwA16RYyFa04xUqierqaQ_XqP-7A)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF132zm0iL8aKMM7J-jwaDud5pTJtlAX-Nt1xcEGNLpdmk17heGUkHd93AZFY6lhfOvFgcyyIF0Tw1290j5IxZzFwixtcjAJRqMBLcc5AI1jaMbTh_QHYEu8TfeNaFge4yshYnlu31D4fq4wja2SYKQVWzxxA4DxvHIz1vDLVx5bSGkn0)
- **Mixed Public Opinion:** On platforms like [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF18tVlu2EHtcqLtgDWj1Uh_ggk0NISmPIbxQKpuYNq1J1z7bZ8u8AJLNIw6Km2gEngIMpYCe1hMKIk2376fqS5YxIPAXPFrkuvh-7Qz8AsHR95omb8i0t3gmzXzZ4HbVSiN7dtPCz0DJk0tl5xcvu28xLTN6cWT7J_LiFeWtj7AOAvUkxR1MkKJ7xTgwP3rA) , opinions are mixed; some users report feeling a difference with products like [ZBiotics](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUAHEIkXXalhOcqJHpEvK7YZaGQiyCSKPxuTFwpy865pWD0UqTknKFBtb3lg1pHqRusM2m_8FkEe5uS-yLeKbAxP4K9jEeuNOdmPEZNHwiPye) , while others view them as overhyped or note that traditional remedies like water and sleep remain essential.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF18tVlu2EHtcqLtgDWj1Uh_ggk0NISmPIbxQKpuYNq1J1z7bZ8u8AJLNIw6Km2gEngIMpYCe1hMKIk2376fqS5YxIPAXPFrkuvh-7Qz8AsHR95omb8i0t3gmzXzZ4HbVSiN7dtPCz0DJk0tl5xcvu28xLTN6cWT7J_LiFeWtj7AOAvUkxR1MkKJ7xTgwP3rA)
